integrity: Direct proof and reproducible finite cross-checks; no independence, external certification, or full literature-exhaustiveness assertion.
scientific_limitations: All-parameter theorem for m,n>=2 only. Prior works already give extremal cardinalities and the all-admissible-set star-forest correspondence. Novelty is claimed only for inclusion-maximal enumeration; an unknown equivalent P4-saturation profile may exist.
title: Maximal outer-mutual-visibility sets of rectangular rook graphs: complete enumerator
